messages:
Sam (AE): Heads-up: Prospect (regional bank) wants BYO-HSM with monthly rotations, attestation receipts, and an SOW clause that Redwood cannot access unwrapped keys. They also want Redwood to be able to trigger rotations within a locked 48h window but without retaining plaintext KEKs.
Priya (Solutions): We can do two approaches: proxy to their KMS (we forward calls, no KEK stored) or envelope-key flow where customer uploads wrapped DEKs. Proxy has latency and network requirements; enveloping needs their ops to supply new wrapped DEK at rotation.
Omar (SE): Quick Q: do they require split-custody for key ceremonies? That affects whether we need to accept multi-signer attestation artifacts.
Sam (AE): Yes, split-custody is in the questionnaire. They also asked for "timestamped attestation logs" and "signed hardware attestation (FIPS/CC) monthly."
Tanya (Crypto): For attestation we accept: a signed attestation blob from their HSM vendor + a SHA256 fingerprint and timestamp. For multi-signer, we can accept N-of-M signed statements but the customer must provide canonical aggregation method.
Evan (Legal): From contract side: we can add the non-access clause. Need to add 1) definition of "no long-term access" 2) acceptance criteria for attestation artifacts 3) an emergency rekey/runbook obligation if they want a rollback within 48h. Also add a liability carve-out if customer loses KEK.
Priya (Solutions): Operational caveats: proxy flow requires stable mTLS tunnels and per-region peering. Expect ~20-40ms added latency; we should offer a "proxy add-on" pricing and include HA tunnels. Enveloping: lower latency impact; we need a small integration to accept wrapped DEKs and validate integrity.
Sam (AE): Pricing guidance please — they asked for a simple example for 150k tokens/day.
Priya (Solutions): Ballpark calc: with Dedicated commit baseline X, envelope integration + storage segregation = +8% uplift. Proxy with HA tunnels + egress = +35% uplift. Final numbers require throughput profile and rotation frequency; I'll draft a sample calc.
Tanya (Crypto): Rotation orchestration: recommend automated choreography where Redwood calls their rotate API (proxy) or expects pre-staged wrapped_dek_vN for envelope. Must define cutover semantics: drain-inflight requests, rotate KV references atomically, and store attestation hashes. I'll write a short runbook checklist.
Omar (SE): For engineering: we'll need a small input schema for attestation metadata (fields: signer_id, signature_b64, hsm_model, timestamp, sha256_of_report). Also an endpoint for customers to upload wrapped_dek files with metadata.
infra-bot: Provisioning note: created staging proxy tunnel for bank-poc, 2x tunnels in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Latency probe scheduled.
Evan (Legal): Also flagging audit retention: prospect wants 7 years of attestation receipts. We can store hashes indefinitely; actual attestation blobs should be stored by customer or in their KMS. Add that to SOW.
Sam (AE): Next actions: 1) Priya to send cost worksheet + two architecture diagrams (proxy vs envelope) 2) Tanya to produce rotation runbook + required attestation fields 3) Evan to draft SOW language (non-access + rekey/runbook + retention). I'll loop in customer after we have artifacts.
Priya (Solutions): I'll upload the sample cost calc by EOD and attach diagrams.
Tanya (Crypto): Runbook draft incoming in 24h.
Evan (Legal): Draft SOW clause in progress, will put in GH for review.
Sam (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
